long_biography.plain_text:
At Ramsey/Beirne, David M. Beirne changed the economics of executive search by accepting equity from promising technology clients instead of cash fees. That placed the recruiter inside the startup ecosystem and created a bridge to venture capital.

He joined Benchmark in 1997, bringing a network built while recruiting leaders for technology companies. After retiring as a general partner, he helped create Fantex, an early attempt to finance athletes against future income. X10 Capital extends that model today through investments tied to professional athletes' future earnings. Beirne remains a general partner, combining talent assessment with investment underwriting. His funds' commitments and portfolio-company values are institutional assets, not measures of his personal fortune.
